**The argument — TTW reference notes**

Moss says he does not usually bet conference winners this far out at even money but could not resist. He notes Texas Tech lived up to the portal spending hype last year by beating 11 opponents by 20 or more, and that while the loaded 2024 group lost a lot, reloading is a way of life in Texas. He cites Pick Six Previews: the average Big 12 team signed two four-star transfers over the past two recruiting periods, and Texas Tech signed 20. He also notes they avoid BYU and Utah in the regular season.

*Rests on:* portal recruiting volume; schedule (avoiding BYU and Utah); prior-season margin of victory

*Conflict or ambiguity:* Moss, Paul Stone and Tim Murray all back Texas Tech in the Big 12 at three different prices and two slightly different markets — the championship and the championship game. All are reproduced separately rather than collapsed into one position.
